intended_object: The homeomorphism X/ker f ≃ₜ Y, for a continuous f : X → Y with a continuous right inverse f'. It is the topological upgrade of Setoid.quotientKerEquivOfRightInverse (from the docstring).
explanation: The underlying bijection is Setoid.quotientKerEquivOfRightInverse: the class of x maps to f x, and y maps back to the class of f' y. The forward map is continuous because it is induced by the continuous map f through the quotient map. The inverse is continuous because it is the projection composed with the continuous map f'. So this is exactly the stated homeomorphism, with no missing or extra conditions. IsQuotientMap.homeomorph in the same file covers the more general case of any quotient map, but noncomputably. This definition is the standard computable variant with an explicit inverse and simps lemmas, which a continuous right inverse makes possible, so it is not a narrower duplicate.
